text:
sara: Auditor Sam asked for an evidence handoff that ties a namespace RoleBinding change to KMS decrypts and a vuln alert. Need mapping to SOC2 CC6.x and ISO A.9.x.
ben: Copy. Which date range? I can pull kube-audit, cloudtrail KMS, and vuln exports.
sam_auditor: Range: 2024-06-10 to 2024-06-14. Deliverables: presigned tarball (7d), manifest.csv with sha256, control_crosswalk.md, reproducible queries, and redaction_log.txt.
ivy: For KMS, include Decrypt and GenerateDataKey. Flag any Decrypts by service accounts within 48h of RBAC adds. Include key metadata and alias mappings.
ben: Splunk snippets I'll run and include saved search text in the tarball. Example: index=kube_audit earliest="06/10/2024:00:00:00" latest="06/14/2024:23:59:59" (verb=bind OR verb=create) | table _time,user,verb,objectRef_kind,objectRef_name,namespace
ben: Packaging path: s3://redwood-audit/3045600000/ with files: manifest.csv, sha256sums.txt, rbacsnap-<commit>.yaml, cloudtrail-kms-slice.gz, kube-audit-slice.gz, key-aliases.json, vuln-scan.json, triage_notes.md, control_crosswalk.md, redaction_log.txt, chain_of_custody.txt.
sara: Add an entry recording who exported, approver, and runbook step IDs. Sam needs PGP-signed manifest or manifest+sha256sums.
evidence-bot: Evidence record: <https://tracker.redwood/EVID-2024-601|EVID-2024-601> created and assigned to ben.
sam_auditor: Also include a one-paragraph risk assessment and recommended remediation if events link. Mark manual redactions as REDACTED.
ben: ETA: stage slices and signature by EOD UTC tomorrow; will post presigned link in ticket and update here.
ivy: I'll also export Splunk index retention settings and S3 lifecycle policy snippet for retention proof.
sara: thanks team. I'll own the control mapping and risk statement.
sam_auditor: Thanks — we'll review on receipt. :thumbsup:
